mcq_fix.s: After the Third Buddhist Council, the missionary Mahadeva was sent to which region?
mcq_fix.why: Mahadeva is not linked to the Amaravati stupa; stem adds a dubious claim

patterns: Direct single-fact items dominate: which inscription names Ashoka (Maski/Gujarra), meaning of Devanampiya, Turamaya/Ptolemy = Egypt.
Two-statement items on Dhamma: Rahulovada Sutta source and Dhamma Mahamatras in 14th regnal year (UPPSC 2024).
Quote-identification items ('minds unpolluted with jealousy' = Ashoka) and 'central point of Dhamma' = peace and non-violence (RAS 2013).
Traps: 1,50,000 deported vs 1,00,000 killed in RE XIII; 13th vs 14th year for Mahamatras; pilgrimage route order.
App MCQs go deeper into regnal-year chronology, edict numbers and missionary lists than the PYQs, and add few AP links (Andhras in RE XIII, Mahishamandala).
